test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

If you damage the property of others you are under a legal _________ to pay for the repairs.
solution: The correct answer is "**Obligation**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence '***If you damage the property of others you are under a legal _________ to pay for the repairs***.' Says that the person will have to pay under legal **provisions** if he damages the property. • ** Obligation**: means **the state of having to do something because it is a law or duty, or because you have promised.(**क़ानूनी बाध्यता या कर्तव्य-भावना, या वचनबद्घता) • ***Example***: *We have a moral **obligation** to help.* • *​*On understanding the meaning of the given word '**Obligation**' and the sense that the given sentence conveys in the question, **Obligation **is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. • Therefore, the correct answer is** option 1.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** __ • ** Let's understand the meaning of the other given options__: ** • **Acknowledgment**: The act of showing that you have seen or noticed somebody/something.(किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की उपस्थिति को स्‍वीकार करने या मान्‍यता देने की क्रिया) • **Requirement**: Something that you need or that you must do or have. (अपेक्षा, ज़रूरत, माँग) • **Appreciation**: Understanding and enjoyment of the value of something(गुण-ग्रहण; समालोचना, गुण-दोष विवेचन) 30:T8f9, The correct answer is "**Be frank and open about something** "
